title: Langley Riders Society
specs: Arena includes main arena, warm up arena, washrooms, PA equipment, and livestock handling facilities
All competitors must wear ASTM or BSI approved helmets with safety harness correctly fastened at all times while jumping on competition grounds
Protective headgear mandatory for participants under 18 years during Games Day
Western attire required for Games Day: long sleeve western shirt, boots, and western hat or games helmet; English tack and attire also allowed but no mixing except snaffle bits
Riders must be neat and tidy; jackets not mandatory; paddock boots with half chaps, tights or yoga pants preferred for jumper shows
Age divisions defined for jumper shows and games days, e.g. Junior 10-13 years, Intermediate 14-18 years, Senior 19-39 years, etc.
Non-member fee: $25 per rider arena fee added to obstacle challenge fees
Family member day rates available for jumper shows and games days
Members have free personal riding use of arena during off times

blurb: Langley Riders Society offers arena and facility rentals for horse shows, clinics, and events. They host English and Western horse shows, jumper shows, games days, and obstacle challenges with various classes and age divisions. Protective headgear and appropriate attire are required for competitions.
extraNote: Damage deposit $150 for regular arena rental, $250 for arena rental with livestock · Cancellation notice must be made two weeks in advance or deposit may be forfeited · Pre-registration and pre-payment required for jumper shows, games days, and obstacle challenges · No penalty if hat falls off while on course but must be on when crossing start line in Games Day
